notes.title: Update 1.0.07 – Mouse Invert Feature Added
notes.content: You can now invert the X and Y mouse axes in the settings menu. This new option lets you customize mouse controls to match your preferred playstyle.

tags.feature: You can now invert the X and Y mouse axes in the settings menu.

notes.title: 1.0.05 – FR Text Fix CH08
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the French text wouldn't display correctly when trying to use the camera in Chapter 08. All set now!
